title: PSK-7 portable sensor kit: simulated system-model export
origin: SIMULATED model export (hand-written JSON). Not produced by Cameo or any modeling tool.

passages.text: Element EQ-PSK7 (Equipment): PSK-7 portable sensor kit. Governed by REQ-001, REQ-002 and REQ-003. Has inspection points IP-HOUSING, IP-BATTERY and IP-SELFTEST.
Element IP-HOUSING (InspectionPoint): Housing seal condition, observed visually and recorded as PASS or FAIL.
Element IP-BATTERY (InspectionPoint): Battery contact condition, observed visually and recorded as PASS or FAIL.
Element IP-SELFTEST (InspectionPoint): Display self-test result, recorded as PASS or FAIL after power-on.
